representation: 17 world positions and 6D joint orientations in one known start-anchor frame; static rest/scale and optional outside-gap observations
selection: Clip/gap/context-balanced validation position error + 0.1 * rotation geodesic radians; confirmation unavailable to selection
notes: Existing confirmation clips were previously inspected for pose studies; not a newly blind corpus.
No raw motion redistribution, new downloads, paid services, runtime package changes or automatic weight promotion.
Validation and confirmation gate comparisons use the strongest of linear/SLERP, Hermite/SLERP and fitted ridge for each metric.
Raw prediction quality is distinct from real-rig projection, contacts, animator quality and Cascadeur parity.
